commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED='eb10cdd70039e82d09cc03231b52ad851fe42546'; git fetch --no-tags origin main >/dev/null; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "${EXPECTED}"; SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | head -n1); test -n "${SERIAL}"; TMP=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "${TMP}"' EXIT; dump(){ adb -s "${SERIAL}" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/blueeye-diag.xml >/dev/null; adb -s "${SERIAL}" pull /sdcard/blueeye-diag.xml "${TMP}/window.xml" >/dev/null; }; tap(){ dump; C=$(python3 tools/ui-smoke/ui_node.py "${TMP}/window.xml" "$1" "$2"); test -n "${C}"; set -- ${C}; adb -s "${SERIAL}" shell input tap "$1" "$2"; sleep 0.7; }; textdump(){ dump; python3 - "${TMP}/window.xml" <<'PY'
import re,sys,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
r=re.compile(r'\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]')
rows=[]
for n in ET.parse(sys.argv[1]).getroot().iter('node'):
 t=(n.attrib.get('text') or '').strip()
 if not t: continue
 m=r.fullmatch(n.attrib.get('bounds',''))
 if not m: continue
 x1,y1,x2,y2=map(int,m.groups()); rows.append(((y1+y2)//2,(x1+x2)//2,t))
for y,x,t in sorted(rows): print(f'{y:4d} {x:4d} {t}')
PY
}; echo '--- navigate Radar -> Settings -> Alerts & Collection ---'; tap content-desc Menu; tap text Settings; tap text 'Alerts & Collection'; echo '--- alerts top ---'; textdump; echo '--- diagnostics scroll 1 ---'; adb -s "${SERIAL}" shell input swipe 540 1900 540 520 500; sleep 0.7; textdump; echo '--- diagnostics scroll 2 ---'; adb -s "${SERIAL}" shell input swipe 540 1900 540 520 500; sleep 0.7; textdump; echo '--- diagnostics scroll 3 ---'; adb -s "${SERIAL}" shell input swipe 540 1900 540 520 500; sleep 0.7; textdump; echo '--- process still alive ---'; adb -s "${SERIAL}" shell pidof io.blueeye; echo 'PHONE_DIAGNOSTICS_UI_CAPTURE=PASS'
